ng-add.description: Convert an existing Angular workspace to Treaty: rewrite angular.json to the @treaty/build builders for every project's build/serve targets and scaffold the Module Federation structure (host + a sample remote, shared Angular singletons) automatically. Zero configuration.

application.description: Generate a Treaty application. Every Treaty app is a Module Federation host automatically and is itself exposable as a remote — wired with zero MF configuration.

library.description: Generate a Treaty library, exposable as a Module Federation remote out-of-the-box with zero MF configuration.
